title: Cross-Desk Reference — An Upgrade Credit Set against a Settlement Figure on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Cross-Desk Reference — An Upgrade Credit Set against a Settlement Figure on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Where a customer settling a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan also holds a registration under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, a credit standing on that registration may be set against the settlement figure. The finance desk reads the upgrade registration record — the standing it carries, the credit still available on it, the credit issued on it, and whether the programme it runs under allows a credit to be spent in part.

## What is set against the figure

| The customer's upgrade registration | The credit set against the figure |
|---|---|
| Stands at credit issued or part spent, and its programme allows a credit to be spent in part | The whole of the credit still available on that registration |
| Stands at credit issued or part spent, and its programme does not allow a credit to be spent in part | The credit issued on that registration |
| Any other case, including a customer holding no such registration | Nothing is set against the figure |

The credit set against the figure is taken off the sum before it is rounded, and it is taken off once and never applied twice.

## Reading the registration

The standing of the registration and the credit figures are read from the customer's registration record under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes; whether that registration's programme allows a credit to be spent in part is a property of the programme the registration runs under. A registration standing at anything other than credit issued or part spent — one awaiting its valuation, one fully spent, one expired or one revoked — falls in the third row.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A customer holds a registration standing at part spent with 600.00 USD of credit still available, the credit issued on it having been 1,500.00 USD. Where the programme allows a credit to be spent in part, 600.00 USD is set against the settlement figure; where it does not, 1,500.00 USD is. Where the same customer's registration stood at fully spent, nothing would be set against the figure.
